title: Nach Fund von Kameras in Damentoiletten – Durchsuchung bei Tatverdächtigem

extraction.placeName: Lichtenberger Campus der Hochschule für Wirtschaft und Recht
extraction.summaryEn: Police searched the home of a 66-year-old man suspected of secretly filming in women's restrooms at a university campus; the cameras had been found there on 10 June 2026. The suspect was released after identification measures and questioning, and evidence analysis continues.
